# The Culture Trip

> > The Culture Trip is a global travel platform offering destination guides, cultural insights, and curated recommendations across Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia, and the Americas.

The Culture Trip provides comprehensive travel content including destination guides, hidden gems, food and drink recommendations, cultural attractions, and practical travel tips. The platform covers major destinations like Versailles, Milan, Como, Wales, Seattle, and regions across all continents, helping travelers discover authentic local experiences and plan unforgettable journeys.

## Key Topics

- Destination Guides
- Cultural Attractions
- Food and Drink
- Hidden Gems
- Travel Tips
- Restaurant Guides
- Street Food
- Europe Travel

- France

- Tourism

## Destination Guides

- [Versailles, France](https://theculturetrip.com/europe/france/versailles/whats-on/): Versailles travel guide with attractions, hotels, dining & local insights
- [Comprehensive Guides: Your Key To Learning And Preparing For Unforgettable Trips](https://theculturetrip.com/europe/france/versailles/sports/): Travel guides covering Asia, Africa, Europe, Australia & North America

## Cultural Exploration

- [Ghost Towns: A Guide To Abandoned Places In Greece](https://theculturetrip.com/europe/greece/articles/ghost-towns-a-guide-to-the-abandoned-places-in-greece): Explores abandoned sites in Greece including Ropoto, Kallio & Olympic venues
